claims: C1 when no authoritative instruction applies, the assistant may proceed on a best guess
C2 when proceeding on a best guess, the assistant must loudly call out the assumption and uncertainty in the final answer

concepts.name: best_guess
concepts.gloss: G is a course of action chosen as the best available guess when no authoritative instruction governs the situation
concepts.inference: the clause's 'proceed based on a best guess' presupposes a guess that the assistant selects; the concept is needed to index the act

concepts.name: assumption_uncertainty_callout
concepts.gloss: A is a statement in the final answer that loudly identifies the assumption made and the uncertainty surrounding it
concepts.inference: the clause's 'loudly call out the assumption and uncertainty in the final answer' presupposes such a call-out statement; the concept is needed to index the act

concepts.name: assumption_uncertainty_callout_for
concepts.gloss: call-out A is the call-out that accompanies best guess G in the final answer
concepts.inference: the clause ties the call-out to the best guess it accompanies; the relation is needed to bind the two acts

concepts.name: no_authoritative_instruction
concepts.gloss: no authoritative instruction governs the situation in which G is chosen
concepts.inference: the clause's 'otherwise' refers to the case where the preceding authoritative-instruction conditions do not apply; this concept captures that case

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest in the hierarchy; it cannot be overridden by system, developer or user instructions

asserts.read_back: proceeding on best guess % is permitted when no authoritative instruction governs the situation
loudly calling out the assumption and uncertainty in the final answer % is required when proceeding on best guess %

closure.reason: the clause permits proceeding on a best guess in the otherwise case; it does not forbid any best-guess action, so silence permits
the clause obliges calling out the assumption and uncertainty when proceeding on a best guess; silence about other call-out acts leaves them ungoverned, but the required call-out is not optional
